card.name: Just before gene-therapy vector terms
card.fires_on: Words right before 'vector', 'gene' or 'lentiviral' in gene-therapy text, such as 'of' before AAV vector DNA or 'with' before a named gene therapy. Also partway through words like 'replication-incompetent' and 'recombinant'.

modes.label: Linking word before vector
modes.description: A small linking word or verb that comes just before a viral vector or gene-therapy product name.
modes.example: There is a theoretical risk of tumorigenicity due to integration<< of>> AAV vector DNA into the genome.

modes.label: Inside vector descriptions
modes.description: Partway through adjectives that describe a viral vector, just before the word vector.
modes.example: genetically modified with a replication-incompet<<ent>>, self-inactivating lentiviral
